text: Having had dental work done here was a terrible experience. It's like an illegal clinic, as other comments have said. It's unclean, the service is poor, and they do additional procedures without informing you beforehand. Each time I went for adjustments, I should have only had to pay for changing the rubber bands and a loose bracket, but instead, I was charged for other things without being informed, and then they charged me later. The dental work was bad and painful every step of the way. I strongly advise against going here. The advertisements are very hype; it looks like a good place, but you're a liar. The dentist is also very slow, sometimes postponing appointments for months. It was a terrible experience.

My dental work here was a terrible experience. The dentist gave me very little advice, the clinic was unclean, and the wait for treatment was incredibly long. The dentist only came to see me for a minute before letting the assistant continue. I wouldn't recommend this place. I endured it until the end because I didn't want to waste the money, especially since my teeth were slightly crooked. The dentist didn't even bother to straighten the uneven teeth; they just removed the braces. Personally, I have a very negative experience. Other clinics are much better. I really regret spending my money here. The dentist's orthodontic skills weren't terrible, but their attentiveness was appalling.

The clinic is really dirty, that's for sure. The air conditioning seems broken, the clinic looks like an illegal clinic. There are so many patients, and it seems like there's no queuing system; the wait is incredibly long. It took a whole day to get my braces' rubber bands changed, even though the doctor only came to examine my teeth for a few minutes before having the assistant do the rest. It's so confusing. They change the rubber bands at each place.
The treatment room is also not clean. The mouthwash cup is extremely dirty; I didn't dare use that cup again, it looked like it had been heavily used. They really need to improve this.
